subject: Integers
title: Below Zero Is Real
subtitle: An account at -$45
headline: Negative is a direction, not a mistake.
quote: It said negative forty-five, so I have nothing.
question: What is the balance after the deposit?

break.text: Part of the deposit fills the hole.

transform.text: What is left goes above zero.

check.text: Walk it on the number line.

comparison.math: It means owing {$45} before you gain anything.

takeaways: Zero is a position, not the bottom.
Adding a positive moves right on the line.

takeaways.text: Debt is a direction you can measure.

philosophy: See the pattern. Change the form. *Keep the value.*
